feature:log_observed_rate.definition: Natural log of one plus accepted records per window-second.
feature:log_observed_rate.interpretationLimit: This is not a raw packets-per-second value; use a unit-labelled tool measurement.

feature:unique_address_fraction.definition: Distinct accepted address values divided by accepted record count.
feature:unique_address_fraction.interpretationLimit: A small positive fraction is not zero addresses or a verified count of physical devices.

feature:address_entropy.definition: Shannon entropy of accepted address frequencies divided by log2 of record count, with a one-record fallback of zero.
feature:address_entropy.interpretationLimit: Address concentration is not the random/public address-type flag or proof of address-generation behavior.

feature:new_address_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records whose address is absent from the supplied previous-address set.
feature:new_address_fraction.interpretationLimit: Zero newly observed addresses does not mean public addresses or absence of random-address flags.

feature:payload_repeat_fraction.definition: One minus distinct accepted advertising-data hashes divided by accepted record count.
feature:payload_repeat_fraction.interpretationLimit: Hash equality is exact data equality, not approximate similarity, intent, constant length, or identity.

feature:random_address_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records carrying the decoded random-address-type flag.
feature:random_address_fraction.interpretationLimit: This does not measure how often an address changes or verify how an address was generated.

feature:manufacturer_ad_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records with a parsed manufacturer-specific AD structure.
feature:manufacturer_ad_fraction.interpretationLimit: This does not authenticate a manufacturer, device, or sender.

feature:adv_ind_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 0 (ADV_IND).
feature:adv_ind_fraction.interpretationLimit: The advertised capability is not proof that a connection was established.

feature:adv_nonconn_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 2 (ADV_NONCONN_IND).
feature:adv_nonconn_fraction.interpretationLimit: Nonconnectable advertising is not a record of whether scanning occurred or a full connection history.

feature:scan_response_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 4 (SCAN_RSP).
feature:scan_response_fraction.interpretationLimit: A record fraction is not a count of unique scanners or all devices present.

feature:adv_scan_fraction.definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 6 (ADV_SCAN_IND).
feature:adv_scan_fraction.interpretationLimit: Scannable advertising is not an observed scan request or proof that a scanner was present.

feature:iat_cv.definition: Population standard deviation of adjacent accepted-record time gaps divided by their positive mean; otherwise zero.
feature:iat_cv.interpretationLimit: Variability alone is not hostility; gaps depend on capture visibility and timestamp validity.

feature:log_mean_iat.definition: Natural log of one plus mean adjacent accepted-record interval in seconds, with an insufficient-interval fallback of zero.
feature:log_mean_iat.interpretationLimit: This is not raw milliseconds; zero may reflect insufficient intervals, not instantaneous activity.

feature:log_max_iat.definition: Natural log of one plus maximum adjacent accepted-record interval in seconds, with an insufficient-interval fallback of zero.
feature:log_max_iat.interpretationLimit: It is not a proof of environmental radio silence or a complete capture-duration measurement.

feature:mean_ad_data_length.definition: Mean length in bytes of extracted accepted advertising data.
feature:mean_ad_data_length.interpretationLimit: An average does not establish constant packet or payload size.

feature:ad_data_length_std.definition: Population standard deviation of extracted accepted advertising-data lengths in bytes.
feature:ad_data_length_std.interpretationLimit: A positive value means lengths vary; do not call them constant.

feature:accepted_kind_contract.definition: This decoder admits legacy advertising PDU kinds 0, 1, 2, 4 and 6.
feature:accepted_kind_contract.interpretationLimit: Scan-request and connection-request traffic is outside these accepted features; do not infer their absence from this vector.

principle:configuration-not-measurement.definition: A configured time window is a rule parameter, not an observed event duration.

principle:selected-absence-not-silence.definition: No matches for selected packet types does not establish absence of all traffic or device activity.

principle:target-not-sender.definition: A target identity is the addressed recipient; it does not by itself establish the sender or successful delivery.

principle:pair-means-both-identities.definition: A same-pair link requires the same client and the same network identity, not merely a familiar name or one matching address.

principle:order-before-link.definition: An exchange before the requests is not a later exchange under a follow-on rule.

principle:correlation-not-cause.definition: A valid time-bounded match supports a correlation, not proof of causation or an outcome.

principle:evidence-not-training-provenan.definition: User-facing uncertainty should describe missing evidence; dataset review status belongs in provenance metadata.

principle:preserve-requested-policy.definition: Explain the supplied policy without inventing or silently replacing thresholds when no policy change was requested.
